name: Polar fleece knit
summary: A napped polyester knit that is light, dries fast and keeps its loft when wet; it replaced wool pile as the mid layer.
how: Knit a polyester fabric with a loop face.
Raise and shear the loops to form a soft, even nap.
Cut the cloth into a jacket with a close collar and a zip.

origin.note: Malden Mills makes a napped polyester knit with Patagonia.

adoptions.via: Polartec fleece goes under the hard shell as the mid layer of the alpine kit.
Gorpcore wears the fleece jacket in the city as a bright outer layer.
